race.description: Industry Awards 13 August Book Now (Bm68) Hcp
race.comment: SARAH'S SONNETS (8) settled at the tail of a small field then let down impressively but just missed out last start over 1800m at this track. Scored at Lismore last prep over 2120m so this trip won't bother her. Very fit after two runs back and she looks the testing material. GOLDEN SMILE (3) improved out of sight last time when second-up from a spell, charging late but just failing to reel in the winner over 2000m at Ipswich. Scored by seven lengths last prep at the NSW provincials in a 2200m Class 1. Getting to this trip third-up will see the best in him. KALKANLI (4) has been in the money at two of three runs over today's trip. One of the chief contenders on a quick back-up. SOUTHBY (2) put in an eye-catcher last Sunday over a similar trip at the Sunshine Coast. Peaking at the right time.
